meta.scope: React frontend and Express API. Excluded: node_modules, build output.
meta.executive_summary: The codebase works but repeats the same API-calling logic in several places and stores the login token where any injected script can read it. Consolidating the API layer and moving the token to a secure cookie would cut duplicated code and close the main security gap.
meta.architecture_summary: Single-page React app calling an Express API. Each feature has its own hand-written API module; there is no shared client, error handling or typing for API responses.

themes.title: Consolidate API access
themes.summary: Replace per-feature axios calls with one typed API client that handles auth and errors.

limitations: Static review only; no code was executed.
Backend auth configuration outside the repository was not reviewed.

findings.title: Duplicated API fetch logic across feature modules
findings.description: fetch_users and fetch_orders are identical apart from the resource name.
findings.why_it_matters: Every fix to auth, error handling or date parsing must be repeated per module; they will drift.
findings.recommendation: Introduce one generic getPage<T>(resource, id) helper in src/api/client.ts and delete the copies.

findings.title: Auth token stored in localStorage
findings.description: The bearer token is read from localStorage on every request.
findings.why_it_matters: Any XSS flaw lets an attacker read and exfiltrate the token and impersonate the user.
findings.recommendation: Issue the session as an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookie from the API and send requests with credentials.
findings.after:
// server: res.cookie('session', token, { httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite: 'lax' });
// client: axios.create({ withCredentials: true })

findings.title: Failed requests are logged and silently return null
findings.description: Non-200 responses log 'failed' and return null; callers cannot distinguish 'not found' from errors.
findings.why_it_matters: Hides outages and produces confusing empty UI states.
findings.recommendation: Let errors propagate to a single error handler in the shared client.
